version_files.format: dotted integers in the `version` key; the merge-time workflow bumps it, a sprint branch never does

repo_conventions.test_command: node chrome-extension/tests.js && node js/tests.js && node js/doc-tests.js
repo_conventions.branch_naming: feature/<label>, fix/<label>, refactor/<label>, chore/<label>, docs/<label>; never claude/ or session/
repo_conventions.commit_convention: Conventional Commits; a vocabulary change is its own docs: commit; no attribution trailer and no generated-by line

sprints.label: detect-comments

Correct each disagreement the source markdown lists under sprint 1. Replace plan labels (S2/S4, D1 / S6, decision D2, app-model-registry sprint) with the reason they stood for, or delete them. Apply the table in section 3.9 of the source markdown to comment text. Remove personification.
sprints.out_of_scope: Any code line; any identifier; comments in other files; the step banners in the geometry probe, the artifact filter, and the right-click resolver; the comments on the link filter's stored result.
acceptance_criteria: git diff shows comment lines alone, and the suite count stays at the baseline of 4,061 passing.
No comment names a function that does not exist in the extension.
No word in section 3.9's Change column remains in a comment in that sense, and every use in the Leave column stands.
Comment lines in the file fall by at least 150.
sprints.dev_notes: Read section 3.8 and section 3.9 of the source markdown first. Keep the comments that state a reason the code cannot: the layout cost of a rendered-text read, the in-place text write, the held-column rule in the column plan, the memo in _ownDescendants. Replace the site name Kaggle with a description of the markup. Run scripts/check-vocab.sh --range origin/main HEAD before the pull request.

sprints.label: detect-unused-logic
sprints.goal: Remove logic that changes no result.
sprints.scope: The geometry probe's step 2 and its class-frequency count, with childCountCandidates no longer returning the frequency map. The self-match loop in the grid adapter's scroll-container lookup. The inner condition in the superscript walk that is always true. The trimmed field on a classified entry and the written-piece list the patch writer returns, each only where no caller or test reads it. In the artifact filter and the positioned-ancestor walk, read the style through the style probe alone; tests that relied on inline style pass a probe.
sprints.out_of_scope: The try blocks around selectors; guards for element stand-ins in tests.
acceptance_criteria: The suite passes with no test deleted, except a test of a removed field.
A new test for step 2 covers the four class-share and count-share cases and shows that no probe input failed step 2 alone.
chrome-extension/README.md lists the probe's steps as the code runs them.
sprints.dev_notes: Step 2 passes when the largest class share or the largest child-count share reaches the floor. Step 3 requires the largest non-zero child-count share to reach the floor, which is never larger than the share step 2 reads. If a test reads trimmed or the written-piece list, leave that item and say so in the pull request.

sprints.label: detect-shared-helpers
sprints.goal: Each rule the file repeats exists once.
sprints.scope: One ancestor walk that takes a cap and a stop test, called by the seven walks with their present caps and stops. The superscript walk and the link filter read pieces through collectTextPieces. One function for the piece that holds a flat position, called by pieceHolding, patchPieceTexts, and showsPiecesTogether. One resolver for the option defaults. chainRootOf and _chainRootOf become one walk. The right-click resolver calls nominateNest in place of findTables. One row builder takes each row's cell elements, called by both adapters and the geometry probe; the native adapter reads each row's cells once and columnPlacement's fallback comes out. The step banners in the geometry probe, the artifact filter, and the right-click resolver become named functions. One type definition each for the record and the piece layout.
sprints.out_of_scope: Any change to a walk's cap or stop; the link filter's search; file moves.
acceptance_criteria: The suite passes unchanged.
parentElement || parentNode appears once in the file.
createTreeWalker appears once in the file.
The file is at least 150 lines shorter than at the sprint's start.
sprints.dev_notes: The probe's cells gain a column plan through the shared builder; section 6 question 3 of the source markdown stands at its recommendation, accept. Two walks have no depth cap today, the hidden-mark walk and the positioned-ancestor walk; the page tree's depth bounds them and they keep that bound.
